psychological_meaning: Deep Sapphire evokes feelings of trust, loyalty, and wisdom. It is associated with intelligence, stability, and efficiency. This color promotes a sense of security and calms the mind, encouraging deep thought and introspection. Deep Sapphire is often linked to authority and sophistication.
